answer: Cluster identities on a correlation graph whose edges come from shared funding wallets, overlapping IP and submission-timing, and invite lineage. Tightly linked accounts merge into one weighted node, so a thousand clones moored in the same harbor are counted once. Every account streaked with the same infrastructure pigment collapses together; only a genuine oasis of independent money, networks, and schedules earns separate standing. A sybil must therefore buy fully de-correlated infra per fake: cost grows linearly per head while cheap duplication buys zero extra influence.
